parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass with a rectangular shape covering the front area.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual content such as images, videos, and text. It is the main interface for viewing output from connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed in position and does not move relative to the base.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum, providing structural support and stability.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen, keeping it upright and stable on a flat surface. It may also contain cable management features.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move, though it may allow limited tilt or rotation depending on design.
